facts.text: PIWrapper wraps a pipython GCSDevice and its docstring lists the GCS2 controller families it supports
PIWrapper.identify() returns the controller identity from GCSDevice.qIDN()
PIWrapper.axis_names returns the controller's axes from GCSDevice.axes
PIWrapper.get_axis_units() queries parameter 0x07000601 for every axis, returns the reported unit and falls back to the default 'mm' when the controller rejects qSPA
PIWrapper.get_servo() reads the closed-loop state of an axis with qSVO
PIWrapper.set_referencing() sends RON and FRF only for an axis that is already referenced
PIWrapper.get_axis_limits() reads qTMN and qTMX for the axis and returns NaN when the command is not available
PIWrapper.connect_device() connects over USB, TCP/IP or RS232 and opens an RS232 line at 19200 baud
PIWrapper.is_referenced() reads the referenced state with qFRF when the device has it
PIWrapper.stop() sends StopAll to the controller
PIWrapper.get_axis_position() reads the position of the axis with qPOS
PIWrapper.move_absolute() sends MOV with the axis name and the position
PIWrapper.move_relative() sends MVR with the axis name and the position when the controller has MVR
PIWrapper.move_home() calls set_referencing(), then GOH or FRF, and falls back to an absolute move to 0
The DAQ_Move_PI plugin declares um as its default controller unit
The DAQ_Move_PI plugin reads axis_names and get_axis_units from the wrapper at initialization
The DAQ_Move_PI plugin stops the controller with controller.stop() in stop_motion()
The README states that the PI actuator plugin covers all stages compatible with the GCS2 library and was tested on E-816, C-863, C-663 and E-545
